name: AMD Instinct MI300X Accelerator product specifications
notes: Board specification table: Bus Type PCIe 5.0 x16, Infinity Fabric Links 8, Peak Infinity Fabric Link Bandwidth 128 GB/s, memory interface 8192-bit at 5.2 GHz data rate, peak memory bandwidth 5.3 TB/s.
